lead.topic: Kaithi: no songs and no heroine, so the one-night clock never stops
lead.insight: Kaithi is set largely in a single night and was shot at night. It has no songs and no heroine, so nothing stops the race of Dilli's lorry. Lokesh Kanagaraj has said the story did not call for a heroine.

caption: Kaithi has no songs and no heroine. Why?

The film is set largely in one night and was shot at night (Wikipedia, Deccan Chronicle). Lokesh Kanagaraj has said the story did not need a heroine. With nothing to pause it, the race never stops. The technique: a ticking clock.
